services.title: Tailored cleaning services
services.subtitle: For homeowners and businesses alike, we work across Haute-Savoie with the same high standards.
services.closing: We handle all types of cleaning work, for individuals and professionals.

items.title: Condominium & Building Cleaning
items.teaser: Common areas, bins and surroundings maintained with rigor to enhance your property's value.
items.approach: Consistent rigor and personalized follow-up to enhance your property's value and offer residents a flawless living environment.

bullets.label: Common area upkeep
bullets.text: Vacuuming and washing of entrance halls, stairways, corridors, elevators and handrails.

bullets.label: Bin management
bullets.text: Taking out, bringing back, disinfecting and regularly washing household waste bins and bin rooms.

bullets.label: Glass surface care
bullets.text: Cleaning of lobby windows, stairwell windows, glass doors and mirrors.

bullets.label: Annex & outdoor areas
bullets.text: Sweeping of bike/stroller rooms, underground car parks, walkways and building surroundings.

bullets.label: Monitoring & traceability
bullets.text: Systematic visit report with information passed on to the property manager or board in case of any anomaly or damage.

items.title: Window & Glass Surface Cleaning
items.teaser: Streak-free cleaning of your glazing, even the hardest to reach.
items.approach: Perfect transparency and optimal clarity thanks to advanced techniques suited to the most demanding architecture.

bullets.label: Prestige & panoramic glazing
bullets.text: Streak-free cleaning of large bay windows, glass balustrades, verandas and glass roofs of high-end chalets or residences.

bullets.label: Adapted techniques for hard-to-reach areas
bullets.text: Safe high-access work on inaccessible glazing (pure water pole, aerial lift).

bullets.label: Complete frame care
bullets.text: Thorough cleaning of frames (wood, aluminum, PVC), sliding tracks, sills and weather seals.

bullets.label: Post-construction decontamination
bullets.text: Degreasing and removal of cement haze, paint marks, resin or glue residue after building work.

items.title: Industrial Cleaning
items.teaser: Strict protocols for clean, safe sites that meet industry standards.
items.approach: Strict hygiene protocols and advanced equipment to maintain the compliance, safety and productivity of your sites.

bullets.label: Floors & large volumes
bullets.text: Sweeping, scrubbing and mechanical treatment of large surfaces (polished concrete, resin, industrial slabs).

bullets.label: Technical & storage areas
bullets.text: Upkeep of warehouses, loading docks, technical rooms and industrial waste management.

bullets.label: Standards compliance
bullets.text: Rigorous application of safety rules (PPE, signage) and sector-specific hygiene requirements (food, chemical, logistics).

items.title: Villa & Chalet Cleaning
items.teaser: A hotel-grade standard for a flawless turnover between every stay.
items.approach: A rigorous hotel-grade standard to ensure your guests' absolute satisfaction and protect the value of your property.

bullets.label: Preparation & fast turnover
bullets.text: Deep cleaning between bookings, full airing out and meticulous tidying of furniture.

bullets.label: Linen & consumables management
bullets.text: Handling of laundry, careful bed-making and restocking of welcome amenities.

bullets.label: Care for premium materials
bullets.text: Maintenance suited to demanding surfaces (raw wood, natural stone, marble, leather and panoramic glazing).

bullets.label: Inspection & reporting
bullets.text: Visual inspection of the property at every visit, with immediate reporting of any damage or forgotten items.

items.title: Professional Premises & Offices
items.teaser: A healthy work environment, maintained without ever disrupting your business.
items.approach: A healthy, valuing work environment for your staff and your clients.

bullets.label: Flexible scheduling
bullets.text: Early-morning or evening visits so your business is never disrupted.

bullets.label: Workstation disinfection
bullets.text: Cleaning of keyboards, screens, handles and frequently touched points.

bullets.label: Regular upkeep
bullets.text: Bin emptying, floor vacuuming/washing, and restocking of restrooms and break areas.

items.title: Tourist Residences
items.teaser: A responsive, large-scale organization built for heavy seasonal turnover.
items.approach: An industrial-scale, responsive organization suited to heavy seasonal turnover.

bullets.label: Flow management
bullets.text: Fast turnarounds between guest departures and arrivals during peak changeover days.

bullets.label: Common area upkeep
bullets.text: Reception hall, elevators, bin rooms and wellness areas (spa, sauna).

bullets.label: Standardized quality
bullets.text: Strict checklists used to guarantee the same level of cleanliness across every apartment.

items.title: Post-Construction Cleaning
items.teaser: A complete cleanup for a building handed over spotless.
items.approach: A meticulous cleanup to hand over a spotless building after construction work.

bullets.label: Intensive dust removal
bullets.text: Elimination of plaster, cement and sanding dust from every surface.

bullets.label: Floor & window stripping
bullets.text: Removal of paint marks, glue, sealant residue, labels and cement haze.

bullets.label: Full disinfection
bullets.text: Thorough cleaning of bathrooms, cupboards and kitchens before occupants move in.
